results.rationale: Consistency: Furniture, window and room layout remain, but the carved wall panel pattern and several cushion/blanket details change. Instruction: A cluster of five floating balloons is added instead of a single regular-air balloon. Knowledge: Balloons float above the bed rather than lying on the floor, contradicting the supplied expectation. Quality: Balloon shapes, room perspective and lighting are coherent without conspicuous artifacts.

Consistency: The blue-and-cream carton, milk lettering, cow graphic and white background remain consistent apart from viewpoint-related geometry. Instruction: The carton rotates only slightly; the broad MILK front remains visible, unlike the reference showing the cow side square-on with the front hidden. Quality: Clean edges, legible lettering and coherent carton structure.
